Then the scan finds no national ID number, phone number, name or account number

  Scenario: AC8 A reader without the right is refused the cost-alert notice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given RW-CASEOWN holds no right for the cost-alert notice
    When the reader calls GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/notices/{noticeId}
    Then the read is refused at gateway-bff with MSG-P4-002
    Then no field of the notice is returned

  Scenario: AC9 The notice service writes only its own rows and reads other services only through their contracts (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the daily step of 2026-12-01 runs with the rwb-agent contract mock and the parameter rows of the rwb-case contract
    When the step completes
    Then the only rows written are notice rows in schema rwb_comms and no agent_run_daily table or lake schema is created
    Then no table of another service is read directly
    Then the template code, the channel, the cap and the alert role are read at run time and no value is held in code
    Then a withdrawn template holds the notice with hold_reason "TEMPLATE_WITHDRAWN" and no message leaves
    Then the delivery time is measured against the 15 minute target and no timeout of 15 minutes is written in code

  Scenario: AC10 An error answer of a provided operation is 401, 403 or 404 and returns no field (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given calls to GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/notices/{noticeId} without a session, without the right and for an unknown noticeId
    When each call is answered with an error
    Then the answer is 401 for the call without a session, 403 for the call without the right and 404 for the unknown noticeId
    Then no field of a notice is returned

  Scenario: AC11 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key returns the first answer and writes nothing new (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write for the "COST_CAP" alert of "SCREENING" on 2026-12-01 was answered under its idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second notice is written
    Then no second message reaches the ACE notification path

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a notice is in state SENT with sent_at set
    When a change of its state to GENERATED is requested
    Then the change is refused with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P6-E1063-APP-AC12)
    Then the state stays SENT and sent_at is unchanged
